description: MMDEC combines maritime observations and spatial context for the Western Celtic Sea, English Channel and part of the North Sea. The Data in Brief article identifies vessel trajectory analysis as its purpose. Zenodo lists twenty-one files, including AIS tracks, Sentinel-1 imagery, ERA5 weather, bathymetry, submarine cables, port and protected-area layers, and wave products. The public release uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Coverage is a selected maritime study region and the component files have different origins and observation scales; the metadata do not establish one uniform time interval or synchronized vessel-weather panel. Incomplete or erroneous tracks remain a limitation when inferring vessel paths. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is constructing traffic scenarios or comparing route exposure to weather and fixed infrastructure. data-world-bank-global-shipping-traffic-density is related aggregate shipping activity, whereas MMDEC provides distinct regional multimodal files. A previous digital-sector candidate excluded this deposit for lacking a telecommunications focus; that reason does not apply to maritime infrastructure. No data archive was downloaded or harmonized.
